simple.meaning: צָבָא (tsâbâʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to mass (an army or servants).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 14 times in Exodus, Numbers, 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, Isaiah, and 2 more, beginning at Exodus 38:8. The surrounding contexts include family line, death, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָבָא (H6633) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: צָבָא (tsâbâʼ) / H6633 is traced through Exodus 38:8, Numbers 4:23, Numbers 8:24, Numbers 31:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.

It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.

This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.

definitions.full: H6633. tsaba [ צָבָא ] verb wage war, serve (Sabean צֿבא wage war with , also noun army, campaign Hom Chrest. 125 CIS iv. 299, 1. 2 DHM VOJ i.28 ; Ethiopic ( > ) wage war ; Assyrian ƒâbu, man, soldier; Nö ZMG xl (1886), 726 and others compare (on account of Sabean, Ethiopic ) Arabic conceal oneself , hence lie in wait ; this is phonetically suitable, but better in meaning would be go or come forth (against one), etc., so Thes Lag BN 21 ; Frä 232 compare young man ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine plural צבְאוּ Exod 38:8 ; Zech 14:12 ; Imperfect 3masculine plural יִצְבְּאוּ Num 31:7 ; Infinitive construct לִצְבֹּא Isa 31:4 ; לִצְבאֹ Num 4:23 ; 8:24 ; Participle plural צֹבְאִים 31:42 ; Isa 29:7-8 , suffix צֹבֶיהָ 29:7 (Ges § 75oo ; Di צָרֶיהָ ); feminine plural צֹבְאֹת Exod 38:8 ; צֹבְאוֺת 1Sam 2:22 ; — 1 wage war, fight , with עַל against , Num 31:7 (P) Isa 29:7-8 , 31:4 ; Zech 14:12 , with suffix Isa 29:7 (?); absolute Num 31:42 (P). 2 serve at sacred tent, Levites, with accusative צָבָא Num 4:23 ; 8:24 (P); women Exod 38:8 (twice in verse) (P) 1Sam 2:22 . Hiph`il Participle וגו אֶתעַֿם ׳הַמַּצְבִּא 2Kin 25:19 = Jer 52:25 muster. .
